authorization: The user explicitly authorized execution of the previously reviewed clean single-P plan, including implementation, retraining, and validation.
question: Can a directly trained single-P affine plastic RNN remove the legacy duplicate observation, constant, normalized-time, reward/action, two-logit, value-head, and blank-step scaffolding while preserving relational competence, evidence binding, organized individual behavior, and observation-training compensation?
claim_boundary: This study tests one fixed H=200 architecture and training recipe on three paired development seeds; it does not establish universal minimality, a human neural implementation, or a population success rate.

Both conditions use the same cleaned 32-channel task interface, single binary margin, affine modulation, no value head, no local memory, and no initial blank steps. The only scientific architecture contrast is the retained versus absent normalized-time drive.

The upstream p/z scaffold may generate the realized observation q, but neither p nor z enters the candidate. Success would establish recipe-level clean single-P sufficiency, not identify p/z or observation noise as a biological mechanism.

Hidden-width, cue-width, P-rank, alpha structure, support/query microstep count, training budget, and P regularization remain fixed. They require later one-factor studies after this structural cleanup passes.

No Liu target, human summary, intervention label, relation type, learned/omitted flag, or evaluation outcome enters training. No seed replacement, checkpoint selection, threshold movement, post-result tuning, or automatic historical-checkpoint deletion is allowed.

design.pairing: Within each seed and observation arm, both architecture conditions use one common 38-channel affine shadow initialization, identical generic task batches, identical q draws, and identical training order. Architecture order alternates by seed and observation-arm order alternates within architecture.
design.exposure_barrier: Train and artifact-lock all 12 final models before computing any generic-validation, Liu, intervention, behavior, or compensation outcome. Training loss is an integrity log only.

channels.31: one realized signed observation q; zero on queries

common.plastic_state: One P in R^(200x200) retained across support trials and reset between episodes; hidden h and eligibility E reset per trial.
common.plasticity: h'=tanh(Wx+b+(W_rec+alpha*P)h); m=u^T h+c; P'=clip(P+mE,-50,50); E'=(1-eta_E)E+eta_E*tanh(h'h^T_old). Preserve the historical P-before-E update order.
common.readout: One learned binary margin M; positive means the left item is ranked higher.
common.query_policy: Every query reads the same terminal P_T with fresh h/E and no P writeback.

time_retained_control.time: A separate scalar drive with 200 learned weights; support indices are normalized from 0 to 2/3 and all queries use 2/3. Time is not part of the 32 task channels.

clean_no_time.time: Absent from the public API, parameters, state_dict, forward computation, and batch tensors; not a zero placeholder.

timestep_accounting.constraint: Both conditions have identical support/query counts. Horizon reduction is outside this study.

initialization_and_optimizer_geometry.shadow: Instantiate one LinearModulationRNN(38,200,2) per seed and map both clean conditions from it without loading a trained checkpoint.
initialization_and_optimizer_geometry.input_mapping: Copy cue/pulse columns 0:31; fold the constant column into input bias; sum duplicate q columns 34 and 37 into clean column31; omit zero reward/action columns; retain time column32 only in the control.
initialization_and_optimizer_geometry.output_mapping: Map the difference of the two legacy logit rows and biases to one margin. Remove the unused value head. Copy W, alpha, eta_E, and the affine modulation head exactly.
initialization_and_optimizer_geometry.paired_identity: All mapped tensors shared by the two conditions must be bit-identical at initialization; clean_no_time must have no time parameter or buffer.
initialization_and_optimizer_geometry.effective_coordinate_adam: Use learning-rate multiplier2 for the folded input bias, folded q weight, and margin weight/bias; multiplier1 for all other parameters. Count those folded gradients twice in the backbone clipping norm. This matches the summed update of the redundant legacy coordinates without retaining them.
initialization_and_optimizer_geometry.optimizer: Adam betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, amsgrad=false; one state per clean parameter; global weighted backbone gradient clip2; no scheduler.

training.task: Generic N=8 connected ranking graphs with 7--10 edges, four support blocks, stable-omission subject encoding, protected Liu graph signatures excluded, and all 28 unordered query pairs equally weighted.
training.observation: clean uses the realized q generated by the inherited p/z scaffold; noisy adds the inherited fixed sigma=1/7 observation error with one deterministic draw per support presentation. The same q is supplied once to each architecture condition.
training.loss: mean softplus(-y*M) over all generic queries plus 1e-4*mean(P_T^2)
training.selection: Final step only; no early stopping, intermediate checkpoint selection, budget extension, learning-rate change, temperature fit, or result-dependent continuation.
training.rng: Generic task stream seed=151000+network_seed. Observation draw seed=410000000+network_seed*10000+step. Store batch, q, and cumulative stream fingerprints for every update.

qualification.fixtures: Use only synthetic non-Liu seeds beginning at 931001; no scientific seed or evaluation panel may be exposed.
qualification.algebra: Independent eager equations must match each clean condition for margin, modulation, h, E, and P within atol=1e-6 and rtol=1e-5.
qualification.mapping: The time-retained clean control must match the active duplicate-q affine shadow forward/loss computation within 2e-6 after exact coordinate mapping.
qualification.optimizer: For eight deterministic updates including P penalty and clipping, transformed effective parameters and Adam moments must remain finite and match the redundant shadow trajectory within 1e-5.
qualification.isolation: Changing or permuting out-of-band time must not alter clean_no_time output, gradients, or update; no time key may appear in its parameters, buffers, input batch, or checkpoint.
qualification.dead_path: Assert no local state, local optimizer group, value output, duplicate q, reward/action channel, constant channel, or blank rollout is constructed.
qualification.timestep: Assert four support steps, two query steps, no blank steps, 168--216 generic active microsteps, and 56--80 effective P writes.
qualification.gradient: Query loss must have finite nonzero gradients through P_T to support-time input, recurrent, alpha, eta_E, and modulation parameters.
qualification.cuda: Eager and compiled CUDA margin, P, loss, gradients, and one update must match within atol=1e-5 and rtol=1e-4.
qualification.failure: Any failed qualification blocks scientific training. Implementation-only repairs must be append-only, must not alter scientific seeds/equations/gates, and must be source-locked before training.

evaluation.panels: Three fixed fresh panels per network. Panel base=731000, stride=100; generic offset0; Liu cue/support/subject/choice/order/query-shuffle/evidence-shuffle offsets11--17. Paired physical inputs and observation draws across architecture conditions.
evaluation.generic: 256 held-out graph-bucket-zero episodes per panel; temperature1; intact and P_off; learned and nonlearned exact-decision probability and CE.
evaluation.liu: Registered liu_v2, 77 participants per panel, temperature0.25; intact, P_off, evidence shuffle, and leave-one-relation-out. Retain learned/nonlearned/omitted probabilities, transitivity, deterministic internal order, five core flags, and historical nine qualitative rows.
evaluation.compensation: For A0,Ae,C0,Ce reproduce global/full Kendall tau, generic and Liu CE, order shift, error_A, error_C, interaction, and training_under_error using participant-paired bootstrap within panel and equal-panel summaries within network.
evaluation.statistics: 2000 percentile-bootstrap draws, 95% intervals, shared participant/episode resamples across paired cells and architecture conditions; never pool networks or panels as independent networks.

decision.integrity: All 12 models complete exactly 1500 optimizer updates with matched paired streams, finite parameters, correct architecture identities, and locked final artifacts before evaluation.
decision.absolute_competence: Every architecture/arm/panel cell must have generic learned and nonlearned exact-decision probability lower95>0.5; every Liu cell must retain learned/nonlearned competence and P/evidence binding under the inherited definitions.
decision.paired_noninferiority: For clean_no_time minus time_retained_control, require lower95>=-0.02 separately for Ce generic learned/nonlearned and Liu learned/nonlearned/omitted probability in each network after equal-panel aggregation.
decision.core_behavior: For clean_no_time, Ae and Ce must each satisfy the inherited five-flag core on at least one of three panels in every network; report all panel failures and all nine historical qualitative rows.
decision.compensation: Within each clean_no_time network, equal-panel I_tau lower95>0, I_CE upper95<0, S_C-S_A upper95<0, and both error tau point estimates<0. Report unresolved intervals without replacement or pooling.
decision.control_validity: The time-retained control must satisfy the same absolute competence and evidence-binding gates. A failed control makes the no-time comparison noninterpretable rather than evidence against time removal.

outcomes.clean_single_p_admitted: All integrity, control, candidate competence, paired noninferiority, core behavior, and compensation gates pass independently in all three seeds.
outcomes.time_removal_failure: The control is valid but clean_no_time fails competence or paired noninferiority.
outcomes.phenotype_incomplete: Both conditions are competent and noninferior, but clean_no_time fails core behavior or compensation.
outcomes.training_recipe_failure: The time-retained control fails mandatory competence or binding.
outcomes.noninterpretable: Qualification, source, artifact, stream, runtime, finiteness, or mandatory execution integrity fails.

decision.stop_rule: After the complete registered result is exposed, freeze and report it. Do not repair a failed seed, add cohorts, alter thresholds, tune training, or begin width/timestep compression under this protocol. A passing result authorizes a separate one-factor capacity-compression protocol, not automatic promotion or deletion.

execution.runtime: CUDA float32 without autocast or TF32; compiled fullgraph/default training; one Torch/BLAS/compiler thread; float64 summaries.
freeze_points: Commit this protocol and study registration before implementing or exposing scientific outcomes.
Commit qualified implementation and source/input lock before training seed3011.
Train all 12 models, jointly artifact-lock and commit them before evaluation.
Evaluate and publish once, preserve positive and negative results, then stop according to the registered outcome.
execution.retention: Keep the protocol, qualification, locks, compact sufficient arrays, canonical result, and report. Do not delete historical or new checkpoints until a later separately authorized retention migration.
